world_read.summary: A faceless black quilted puffer hood with two glowing red star-glint eyes sits in the central recessed niche of a pale grey plaster wall. Below it, a wall of stacked black puffer cushions is laced with speckled drawcords, toggles, and draped cord swags, and the hood's own drawstrings hang over the top cushion.
